authority: human-requested audit and aggressive roadmap revision

candidate.repository_state: dirty, nothing staged, main one commit behind origin/main

summary: The happy path is well implemented and well tested, but the claimed canonical authority and contradiction blocking are not trustworthy under adversarial use. A caller can impersonate an authority actor, duplicate contradictory status sections pass reconciliation, stale decision-relevant projection fields pass, and one malformed canonical event permanently bricks an append-only ledger. S-001 is not complete.
verification_notes: The supplied native Windows Node v25.2.1 full-suite result remains the only complete-suite evidence: 120 files, zero failures.
Independent focused execution passed 37 truth, status, readiness, context, replay, and custody tests after the D078 roadmap/status update.

Independent direct execution of the ten serial files produced 48 passes, 3 intentional skips, and 1 environment-only failure: the connector runtime is Node 18.19.1 while execution custody correctly requires Node >=20. All package, ready, judge, release, and process-tree cases in that set passed.
Two complete-runner attempts through the local connector were not counted: one returned a connector 502; one exited without a final summary after many passing parallel files.
positive_evidence: The supplied full native Windows suite evidence is internally consistent: 120 files, zero failures.
Independent focused execution passed 37 existing truth, status, readiness, context, replay, and custody tests.
Core direction fields are generated from the latest valid canonical snapshot on the normal happy path.
status without --refresh fails without mutation for a simple changed material field.
status --refresh regenerates from events, readiness includes MH_TRUTH_001, and the public context path checks truth before scoring, hints, writes, or override.
Worker events do not replace Goal, Phase, Current truth, Next action, or Stop criteria when the worker honestly identifies itself as a worker actor.

findings.title: Canonical authority is self-asserted and impersonable
evidence: lib/commands/event.js:30-46 accepts actor and authority directly from CLI arguments.
lib/truth-reconciler.js:34-40 and 92-99 validate only membership in a string allowlist and non-empty authority text.
Independent probe successfully appended canonical truth with --actor controller --authority FAKE-AUTHORITY and exited 0.
findings.impact: Any worker or process with CLI access can publish roadmap direction by claiming to be controller, human, or product-owner. The worker-authority separation is not enforced.
findings.required_repair: Replace actor-name trust with a capability-bound canonical mutation path. Require a controller/human authority receipt whose digest binds the prior canonical snapshot, exact proposed snapshot, allowed mutation, expiry, and one-time use. The general event command must not accept a free-form authority actor as proof.

findings.title: Duplicate material status sections bypass contradiction blocking
evidence: lib/truth-reconciler.js:231-245 overwrites duplicate labels in an object.
lib/truth-reconciler.js:249-252 compares only the last parsed value for selected labels.
Independent probe inserted wrong Goal, Current truth, Next action, and Stop criteria before correct duplicate sections; reconcileTruth returned ok=true.
findings.impact: status and readiness can display contradictory material truth while MH_TRUTH_001 passes.
findings.required_repair: Delete section-level permissive comparison. Compare the complete normalized projection byte-for-byte or compare a canonical projection hash, and reject duplicate, missing, reordered, or extra sections. No backward-compatible permissive parser is required.

findings.title: Decision-relevant projection fields can be stale or fabricated while truth passes
evidence: lib/truth-reconciler.js:60-67 excludes Active streams, Pending human decisions, Blockers, and Last verified from contradiction comparison.
Independent probe changed Active streams and Last verified; reconcileTruth returned ok=true.
lib/truth-reconciler.js:175-187 treats every historical decision or blocker event as current and accepts the latest evidence string from any actor as Last verified.
The live status consequently lists many closed D017-D076 records under Pending human decisions.
findings.impact: A worker can overwrite Last verified with unverified evidence, historical decisions appear pending, and planning can proceed from misleading current-state fields even though core direction fields match.
findings.required_repair: Make every rendered field typed and authority-scoped. Independent verification must be explicit; pending gates and blockers require lifecycle state, not presence in history. Prefer removing unsupported inferred sections from status rather than building more governance machinery. Then validate the entire projection exactly.

findings.title: Malformed canonical history is unrecoverable under append-only rules
evidence: lib/truth-reconciler.js:115-136 blocks when any canonical-marked event in history is invalid.
lib/truth-reconciler.js:325-327 advises recording a valid snapshot, but a later valid snapshot does not clear the invalid historical record.
Independent probe with one invalid canonical event followed by a valid human snapshot remained blocked with TRUTH_CANONICAL_INVALID.
findings.impact: One malformed or unauthorized truth_snapshot event permanently bricks status, readiness, and planning unless history is edited, violating the append-only recovery model.
findings.required_repair: Add an authority-bound append-only reconciliation event that names the rejected event hash and prior canonical hash, or otherwise define a deterministic recoverable supersession rule. Recovery must never require mutation of historical events.

findings.title: The public context command reports a truth block with process exit code 0
evidence: lib/commands/context.js:117-123 prints the result without raising a CLI failure.
The existing test explicitly expects status 0 for a truth-blocked context request.
findings.impact: Shell or CI callers that rely on process success can continue despite a canonical truth block.
findings.required_repair: Return a non-zero process exit for truth-blocked public context checks while preserving structured JSON on stdout. No compatibility alias or success-mode fallback.

scorecard.note: ROUND-018 score 9 measured context-gate sufficiency, not implementation correctness, authority integrity, product progress, or shipping readiness. It must not be reused as the product score.

aligned: The work addresses a real blocker: contradictory canonical truth.
The implementation remains a bounded local CLI/library change rather than a daemon, queue, adapter expansion, or swarm.
deviations: Governance gravity: the current roadmap schedules multiple horizontal truth, projection, corpus, handoff, runtime, and identity slices before the first real coding loop.
Activity substitution risk: 40 modified tracked files and roughly 1.4k changed lines support an unaccepted internal slice, while no new end-to-end shipped product outcome exists.
Authority drift: role names are treated as authority despite the locked separation between human, controller, auditor-planner, and worker.
Score drift: a context quality score was presented as if it supported implementation closure.

roadmap_revision.principle: Repair only the proven S-001 blockers, integrate the slice, then immediately prove one real end-to-end coding loop. Defer horizontal infrastructure until an observed product slice cannot ship without it.

ordered_gates.name: Canonical truth hardening
ordered_gates.exit: Capability-bound canonical mutation; exact whole-projection validation; typed or removed decision-relevant fields; append-only recovery; non-zero truth-block exits; adversarial tests and independent audit pass.

ordered_gates.name: Upstream-aware integration
ordered_gates.exit: Reconcile origin/main 0791efa without losing unrelated dirty work; full supported-runtime suite and package proof pass; S-001 is committed as one reviewable candidate and independently accepted.

ordered_gates.name: First real single-worker coding loop
ordered_gates.exit: One non-fixture product change runs frozen audit -> intent reread -> three alternatives -> bounded RunSpec -> existing execute custody -> independent audit -> canonical disposition, and reaches an explicit merged and packaged terminal state.

ordered_gates.name: Evidence-led enabling work
ordered_gates.exit: Implement only the smallest projection, intent, corpus, handoff, resume, runtime, or identity change that the real loop proves is blocking the next shipped outcome.

deferred: S-001A as a standalone projection program; fold only required provenance into S-001R.
S-001B as a standalone intent-anchor program; the existing locked intent document remains the authority until the real loop proves injection failure.
S-005/S-005A as a standalone corpus program; add adversarial cases to each active slice instead.
S-006A/B/C broad continuity implementation before the first real loop; derive the minimum handoff/resume contract from observed failure.
S-002 and S-004 unless they become direct release or user-adoption blockers.

next_gate.action: Implement S-001R only, preserving unrelated work and the D077 evidence set. Do not start S-001A, S-001B, a corpus program, handoff infrastructure, or multi-agent work.
required_adversarial_tests: authority receipt tampering, replay, expiry, wrong prior snapshot, and wrong proposed snapshot are rejected
duplicate, missing, reordered, extra, and stale status content blocks
worker evidence cannot become Last verified
closed decisions do not appear pending and cleared blockers do not remain active
invalid canonical history is repaired by an append-only authorized reconciliation event
truth-blocked context exits non-zero without writes, scoring, hints, or override
next_gate.stop_criteria: No S-001 completion claim, integration, roadmap advance, or ok:true reliance until all critical and high findings are closed and independently re-audited.
